result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signals. However, the wide roadway and lack of mid-crossing refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Vehicle proximity to crosswalk
hazards.description: A vehicle is positioned very close to the crosswalk while pedestrians are present on the sidewalk nearby, indicating potential conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Grey car in the middle of the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-modal intersection featuring tram tracks and a multi-lane roadway. Pedestrian infrastructure includes marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and a tram platform serving as a refuge island, but the overall crossing distance is substantial.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway and tram tracks create a long unprotected crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Tram Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks can cause tripping for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island Enhancement
interventions.description: Broaden and better protect the waiting area between the tram tracks and the vehicle lanes.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked crosswalk, curb ramps, and a sidewalk. However, the environment lacks visible pedestrian-specific signals and features dense vegetation that may obstruct sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes at the corner may block sightlines for drivers turning right toward the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking in the asphalt within the intersection area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to clarify right-of-way.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or set back vegetation at the corner to ensure clear sight triangles for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to a continental or ladder pattern for better visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous sidewalk on the left and a marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection in the distance. However, the presence of streetcar tracks and degraded pavement in the roadway introduces tripping hazards. The lack of physical separation between the sidewalk and the travel lanes reduces the overall sense of safety.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Tracks embedded in the roadway can cause trips or falls, especially if the pavement around them is uneven.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and patching in the asphalt can lead to tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground of the image in the center of the travel lane

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and patched asphalt to provide a smooth, level surface for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace the existing transverse crosswalk markings with high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.
